timeframe_evidence: comments say days; module consumes route candles; no day/4h route enforced
entry: high>=current-inclusive Donchian20.upper => long; elif low<=Donchian20.lower => short
exit: exit_signal: high>=Donchian10.upper => exit_short; elif low<=Donchian10.lower => exit_long; liquidate on opposite entry or direction-matching exit
sizing: qty=(balance*0.01)/(ATR20*dollars_per_point), default multiplier1; no fee haircut/notional cap
pyramiding: strict price movement >0.5*current ATR from last_opened_price, current_pyramiding_levels<4; counters mix submission and on_increased_position callback
skip_profit: flag set only in source on_take_profit; S1_filter consumes/reset once; modern inspected dispatch does not invoke legacy take-profit/stop-loss hooks
